user.title: Voice Broadcast
user.description:
This adds a push-to-talk card to your dashboards. You choose which speakers it can reach when you add the card.

Recording needs a secure connection. Open Home Assistant over HTTPS (Nabu Casa or your own certificate), otherwise your browser will block the microphone.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Voice Broadcast is already set up.

init.title: Voice Broadcast
init.description:
Speakers fetch recordings over HTTP. By default they are given the Home Assistant address from Settings → System → Network.

If your speakers cannot reach that address — common when Home Assistant sits behind a reverse proxy — enter the address they should use instead. Leave empty to keep the default.

data_description.base_url: For example https://home.example.com, with no trailing path. Must be reachable from the speakers themselves.

error.invalid_url: Must start with http:// or https://
